app.title: Flet 1.0 – Build cross-platform apps in Python
app.author: absqueued
app.description: A Python framework for building cross-platform mobile, web, and desktop applications using a single codebase.
proposed_tests: run a minimal hello‑world app and ensure the server starts without errors
measure startup time and compare against a Flask equivalent
open the app in a browser and verify UI renders correctly
run the app in headless mode and capture a screenshot to check rendering consistency
